name: Hop & Pop

gist.Bubbles, the Bouncy Bunny: A very tough hero who can take any damage aimed at Inya's creatures himself. If he goes down that way, Inya refills her hand.
gist.Bunny Bombs: A tiny creature that collects a Bomb Counter at the end of every turn (both players'). When it dies it blasts every target on the board, harder for each counter. If that blast would end the game in a draw, its controller loses.
gist.Haressassin: Fragile creature that strikes one target hard every turn, starting the turn after it arrives.
gist.Winged Haressassin: Once per turn Inya may discard a card to pull a hit aimed at one of her other targets onto this creature; if it dies that way it strikes back hard at any target.
gist.Cute Bunny: Hops onto the board for free whenever Inya discards two cards at once, and draws her a card each time that happens.
gist.Cute Annoyance Mini: Discards a card to fetch a Cute creature, a second card to summon it at once. Her discard outlet.
gist.Maya, the Nature Fairy: Every creature that enters makes one of Inya's targets a bit sturdier.
gist.Cheering Rabbit: Its hero's first attack or spell each turn hits harder.
gist.Aggressive Town Guard: Free first summon of the turn; pings one target each turn.
gist.Harpyformer Choir: Free first summon that fetches a Summoning Magic and can shield a creature from one hit.
gist.Cannon Tower: Sturdy late creature that fires a strong shot every turn.
gist.Skull Necklace: Does nothing when played; when Mini discards it, it stings a target.
gist.Teal Fishing Rod: Returns a small creature (Bunny Bombs, Cute Bunny) from the discard pile to the board.
gist.Deepsea Idol: Reaction that cancels a sweep hitting two or more of her creatures.
gist.Thicket: Makes one creature untargetable for a turn.
gist.Heal: Patches Bubbles up after he has soaked a turn of damage.

plan: Inya goes wide with cheap creatures and lets Haressassins strike while Bubbles absorbs whatever is thrown at them. In the back a Bunny Bombs ticks; Inya decides when it goes off, because Bubbles can keep it alive, and a late blast flattens a board she is happy to trade away. Deepsea Idol and Thicket protect the strikers, Heal keeps Bubbles standing. The deck is fast but thin: every point Bubbles soaks is real, and once he falls the creatures die to a breeze and the bomb is as dangerous to Inya as to you.

looks.early: A Town Guard and a Harpyformer Choir out for free, Bunny Bombs set down with its first counter, Bubbles untouched.
looks.mid: Several Haressassins spread across the heroes, the bomb ticking in the back row, Bubbles visibly chewed up from catching hits meant for them.
looks.late: A swollen Bunny Bombs, a Cannon Tower, a tired Bubbles being healed; Inya counting counters out loud.

opening.tell: A fresh Haressassin has just landed and cannot strike until next turn; the Bunny Bombs has barely a counter on it.
opening.why: Freezing or stealing the first Haressassin (Snow Cannon, Dark Gear) or setting the bomb off yourself with The Yeeting while it has a counter or two (The Yeeting counts as a kill, and so early the blast only hurts her own small creatures) costs her the tempo the whole deck lives on; racing into Bubbles, the fattest hero in the room, does not.

midgame.tell: She is wide with fragile creatures and Bubbles already looks worn from soaking; the bomb still has only a few counters.
midgame.why: A sweep now (Flame Avalanche) forces Bubbles to either eat a whole board's worth of damage or let the Haressassins die, and a bomb popped early is harmless; waiting just adds counters and strikes.

crisis.tell: The Bunny Bombs is loaded with counters and sits next to your Storm caster's line of fire.
crisis.why: Anything that kills the bomb now, a sweeper or The Yeeting alike, sets the full blast off on your own heroes; Chain Lightning and Acid Vial hit only heroes, so finish Bubbles and leave the bomb exactly where it is.

endgame.tell: Both sides are low and the bomb is still on her board; a draw caused by Bunny Bombs counts as a loss for its controller.
endgame.why: With heroes this low the bomb can no longer save her: if it would take everyone down, she loses, so every card should go at her last heroes.

opening.board: Inya opens with an Aggressive Town Guard and a Harpyformer Choir for free and sets a Bunny Bombs behind Bubbles.

options.text: Detonate the Bunny Bombs with The Yeeting while it has one counter
Ignore it and stack Destruction Magic towards the Storm
Chain Lightning straight into her heroes

opening.board: A first Haressassin lands under Maya; it cannot fire yet. Mini discards a Skull Necklace to nick one of your heroes.

options.text: Snow Cannon the Haressassin and keep it out of the game
Flame Avalanche her three small creatures
Hit Mini, her smallest hero, with everything

opening.board: Cute Bunnies hop in as Mini discards two cards; Inya's hand refills, her board is all tiny bodies.

options.text: Steal the best creature with Dark Gear
Use the quiet turn to find Gathering Storm
Set Firewall and poke Mini

midgame.board: She has gone wide with several Haressassins while a Bunny Bombs ticks in the back row; Bubbles has been catching every stray hit.

options.text: Flame Avalanche the whole board and make Bubbles choose
Detonate the bomb with The Yeeting while the blast is still small
Keep building, the Storm will handle it

midgame.board: Two Haressassins and a Cheering Rabbit; Inya holds a Deepsea Idol-sized grin and two cards.

options.text: Sweep twice: the Idol only stops the first
Freeze one striker and hit Bubbles
Everything at Mini and hope

midgame.board: Bubbles has soaked a full turn of your Storm and Inya spends her action on Heal.

options.text: Keep sweeping, Bubbles cannot soak forever
Dark Gear a Haressassin and turn it on her
Dig for The White Eye instead of pressing

crisis.board: The Bunny Bombs is fat with counters and Inya is smiling at it; your heroes are in blast range.

options.text: Chain Lightning and Acid Vial at heroes; touch nothing else
Cloud in a Bottle ready in case she pops it herself
Sweep or Yeet the bomb and take the blast

crisis.board: Bubbles is one good hit from falling, and if he drops from soaked damage Inya redraws a full hand.

options.text: Aim past the creatures and kill a different hero
Steal the bomb with Dark Gear so its timing is yours
Cataclysm and take the blast

crisis.board: A Cannon Tower has joined the Haressassins; the bomb keeps ticking; you hold Dark Gear and Tea.

options.text: Hero damage only: Chain Lightning, then Acid Vial on Bubbles
Freeze the Tower, hit the weakest hero
Steal the Cannon Tower and point it at Bubbles

endgame.board: One hero each is nearly gone and the loaded Bunny Bombs still sits there; if it levels everything, its controller loses.

options.text: Acid Vial and Chain Lightning at her last healthy hero
Protect your lowest hero and let the Storm tick
Reshuffle for a better hand

endgame.board: Inya fishes a Bunny Bombs back with Teal Fishing Rod; Bubbles is gone, her creatures have no shield left.

options.text: Ignore the new bomb and end it
Sweep the unprotected creatures
Rebuild your Storm caster first

endgame.board: She is down to Mini and a Haressassin; you have one hero and a ticking Storm.

options.text: All in on Mini
Snow Cannon the Haressassin, then hit Mini
Clear the Haressassin and wait
